questions.question_text: Provide a detailed summary (80-100 words) of 'The Kites', highlighting the character actions and moral outcome.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Daphne Lister uses vivid sensory imagery and poetic devices. The simile 'like coloured birds' visualizes vibrant movement across the 'wind-whipped sky'. Personification appears when the 'wild wind sings' its songs. Spatial imagery lets readers feel the bird's-eye view looking down on green parks and town rooftops, capturing the ultimate childhood joy of flight.
